Subject: QBR: Strategic pipeline concierge & account annotations

Team —

Putting a short thread together for the QBR working session next Friday. I pulled the latest numbers and annotated accounts where the forecast deviates materially from the ARR model. High-level asks below: 

- Owners: please confirm the commit / best / upside numbers in the attached QBR_pipeline_master_v3.xlsx by EOD Thursday (11/05).
- For Novacore, we need a one-paragraph account annotation explaining the renewal cadence and any procurement timing risk. I started a draft in Novacore_account_annotations_v2.pdf — feel free to edit and return.
- Olga: can you run a quick historical conversion check on the BD reps listed under NW-2026-Q4-17? I flagged a couple of outliers.

I will consolidate into the executive slice after your updates and send to the board readout pack. Small, focused edits preferred — this is for execs, not the playbook.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rafael — I updated the sheet (tab: Field Adjustments) with commit/best for the accounts I own and left comments where the rep's notes conflict with the forecast assumptions. Two quick notes: 

1) Novacore: I added a note about procurement calendar misalignment — they do a quarterly vendor committee and it looks like they won't reconvene until mid-December, which pushes close past our Q4 target. I marked funding as "probable" not "committed".
2) Bankside (Jamal): Jamal confirmed a PO is pending but legal review is longer than usual. I added a MAP stub.

I'll chase Annika for the annotation, but if procurement delays are as I see, Novacore will need a short mitigation plan in the executive box.

Marissa

Hi Marissa / Rafael —

Thanks for the heads up. Confirming Novacore's procurement committee meets the week of 14 Dec; current internal signals put this as a Dec close at the earliest. I've attached a short note on our vendor approval steps and a proposed schedule for a pilot deployment to accelerate exec signoff.

Two asks from our side: 
- Can Redwood provide a one-page security attestation summary we can include in the committee packet?
- Is there flexibility on the implementation SLA if we need to run in a private VPC for the pilot?

I can jump on a 30-min call next Tue if that helps.
\Best,
Annika
Head of IT Procurement
Novacore

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Strategic pipeline concierge & account annotations

Rafael / Marissa —

I ran the BD conversion sanity check you asked for. Findings (short):
- Two reps (listed in the sheet comments) had historic over-optimism in commit columns; I adjusted their conversion factor to field-average and left detailed notes in the "Model Adjustments" tab.
- Novacore's history shows renewals close at end-of-quarter ~65% of time when procurement is engaged in Q4; when procurement slips to December, close rate drops to ~28%.
- Bankside (Jamal) looks like a healthy late-stage deal; legal timelines are the single gating risk.
\I attached the small CSV with the conversion delta and linked a Google Sheet that overlays the adjusted ARR. Recommend we present two slices in the exec deck: (1) conservative (adjusted-conversion) and (2) consensus (field-commit). I'll flag Novacore as an 'timing risk' in the exec slide.
\Olga
Olga Petrov
Revenue Analytics Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: conversion_delta_nov_07.csv (csv, 12KB)
Link: https://drive.google.com/spreadsheets/d/adjusted_arr_overlay

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: QBR: Strategic pipeline concierge & account annotations

Thanks all — quick status update and plan for Monday prep: 

- Marissa: thanks for the MAP and field updates. I'll pull the Novacore annotation (Annika's note) into the executive box. Please convert your sheet comments into a single 2–3 line rationale per account by 10am Monday.
- Olga: great work on conversion deltas — we'll present conservative + consensus slices as you suggested. Add the delta CSV into the drive overlay (same folder).
- Tessa: can you please add two bullets to the exec slide deck: (1) high-level mitigation for Novacore timing risk, (2) proposed fall-back model (use dedicated capacity + pilot SLA) if procurement requires private deployment. I'll include the bullets in the readout.
\I'll assemble the final QBR snippet (one page per account) and circulate to the Leadership Review list by 11/08 18:00 PST. If anyone sees a place where messaging would hurt close probability (language about "commit" vs "probable"), flag it now.
\Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
